requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C1 - court and county where the juvenile record is located
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C1 - court and county where the juvenile record is located
requiredBeforeFiling.why: 10A O.S. Sec. 2-6-109 turns on this fact as the compiled Oklahoma profile records the route, and it lives on a court or agency record the platform has never seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Oklahoma district court and county where the juvenile record is located - copy it from the juvenile court's own disposition, dismissal or closure order, or ask the clerk of that court

requiredBeforeFiling.why: 10A O.S. Sec. 2-6-109 turns on this fact as the compiled Oklahoma profile records the route, and it lives on a court or agency record the platform has never seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number of the juvenile case whose record is to be sealed - copy it from the juvenile court's disposition, dismissal or closure order

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C3 - nature of the disposition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C3 - nature of the disposition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: 10A O.S. Sec. 2-6-109 turns on this fact as the compiled Oklahoma profile records the route, and it lives on a court or agency record the platform has never seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which of informal adjustment, deferred adjudication, probation or custody the juvenile case ended in - copy it from the juvenile court's disposition order

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C4 - date of the disposition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C4 - date of the disposition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: 10A O.S. Sec. 2-6-109 turns on this fact as the compiled Oklahoma profile records the route, and it lives on a court or agency record the platform has never seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date the disposition was entered - copy it from the juvenile court's disposition order

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C5 - date the requirements were completed
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C5 - date the requirements were completed
requiredBeforeFiling.why: 10A O.S. Sec. 2-6-109 turns on this fact as the compiled Oklahoma profile records the route, and it lives on a court or agency record the platform has never seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date every requirement of the informal adjustment, deferred adjudication, probation or custody was completed - copy it from the completion or discharge record, or from the written confirmation of the office that supervised it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C6 - date the case was dismissed or closed
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C6 - date the case was dismissed or closed
requiredBeforeFiling.why: 10A O.S. Sec. 2-6-109 turns on this fact as the compiled Oklahoma profile records the route, and it lives on a court or agency record the platform has never seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date the juvenile case was dismissed or closed - copy it from the juvenile court's dismissal or closure order, which the committed contract names as a component of this packet

requiredBeforeFiling.why: 10A O.S. Sec. 2-6-109 turns on this fact as the compiled Oklahoma profile records the route, and it lives on a court or agency record the platform has never seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether any adult arrest, charge, indictment or information is pending, and if so what and where - check it against a current Oklahoma State Bureau of Investigation criminal history record rather than answering from memory

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C8 - court costs, restitution, fines and ordered requirements
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C8 - court costs, restitution, fines and ordered requirements
requiredBeforeFiling.why: 10A O.S. Sec. 2-6-109 turns on this fact as the compiled Oklahoma profile records the route, and it lives on a court or agency record the platform has never seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether all court costs, restitution, fines and ordered requirements are completed, and the date the last was satisfied - copy it from the clerk's payment history or receipt for the juvenile case

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C9 - law-enforcement agency holding the related file
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C9 - law-enforcement agency holding the related file
requiredBeforeFiling.why: 10A O.S. Sec. 2-6-109 turns on this fact as the compiled Oklahoma profile records the route, and it lives on a court or agency record the platform has never seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the law-enforcement agency or agencies holding the files related to this juvenile record - copy the agency name from the arrest or referral paperwork in the juvenile court file, or ask the clerk of that court
